# Mouser.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/mouser-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/mouser-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects product data from Mouser.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Mouser.com in 2026](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-mouser-com-in-2026)
- **Code:** [`mouser.py`](mouser.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Product](results/product.json) · [Search](results/search.json)

## What it scrapes

- Mouser product pages
- Mouser product search

## Functions

- `scrape_product(urls)` → `List[MouserProduct]`: Scrape Mouser product pages
- `scrape_search(query, max_pages=3, scrape_all_pages=False)` → `MouserSearch`: Scrape Mouser search pages for product listings Args: query: Search query string max_pages: Maximum number of pages to scrape (default: 3) scrape_all_pages: If True, scrape all available pages (overrides max_pages)

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import mouser


async def main():
    search = await mouser.scrape_search("Tool boxs")


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields:

- **`MouserProduct`**: `product_id`, `part_number`, `manufacturer_part_number`, `manufacturer`, `description`, `price`, `currency`, `availability`, `stock_quantity?`, `images`, `specifications`, `datasheet_url?`, `url`
- **`MouserSearch`**: `products`, `scraped_pages`, `total_pages`, `total_count`

A field marked `?` can be `null`.

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`mouser.py`](mouser.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `asp` = `True`: Anti Scraping Protection, the earlier name of the [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)
- `render_js` = `True`: render the page in a real browser
- `retry` = `True`: retry a failed request

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/mouser-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_product_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
